# testdata

## ZEXALL and ZEXDOC

`zexall.com` and `zexdoc.com` are the Z80 instruction exercisers written by
Frank D. Cringle and released into the public domain.

- **ZEXDOC** tests all documented Z80 instructions and flag behaviours.
- **ZEXALL** additionally tests undocumented opcodes and flag bits (F3/F5,
  SCF/CCF quirks, MEMPTR, IXH/IXL, SLL, etc.).

Original source and documentation:
<https://retrocomputing.stackexchange.com/a/6971>

The binaries are assembled from Cringle's original `zex.src` and are in wide
use across the Z80 emulation community as a de facto correctness standard.
